d:
The world feels very loud right now. And sometimes I don't know what to do with that heaviness, except to pick up the handpan. Not to escape, but to remember that underneath all the noise, there is still something steady, something calm. Something that doesn't shake. The sound brings me back every time. Deeply grateful that the handpan found its way into my life
